Where support goes

You’re already welcome here—transparency only, not pressure.

This is a Bible-teaching ministry. The mission is simple: help people know the KJV for themselves and steward the gifts God has placed in their hands—practically, quietly, without hype or pressure.

Gratitude, not guilt—read this when you want the honest picture. For plain monthly build notes, see Monthly updates. For print and offline-friendly packs, see Print hub and Prayer Wall (anonymous requests stay gentle).

Give securely Support levels

The mission at a glance

Human-curated. Privacy-first. KJV only. Built and run by one person, learning as he goes, with family and God’s help.

Daily encouragement is the front door—but the deeper goal is equipping people to actually know their Bible and put what God gave them to work: their gifts, their calling, their daily life. No seminary required. No performance. Just honest Scripture and practical next steps.

Every dollar of support helps keep that door open for anyone who walks through it, and funds the teaching that goes deeper once they do.

Where support actually goes

  • Infrastructure & security. Hosting, CDN, dependency maintenance, KJV data upkeep, and offline reliability so the porch is open when someone needs it at 2 a.m.
  • Teaching content. New Battle Plans, Bible study tracks, workbooks, course materials, family printables, and pastor resources—all reviewed and written by hand, no AI generation.
  • Free outreach. Printable packs sent to prisons, hospitals, missionaries, new believers, and small churches that cannot pay. This is a priority, not an afterthought.
  • Ministry operations. The builder’s time to create, maintain, and grow this—disclosed honestly. “The labourer is worthy of his reward.” —1 Timothy 5:18. As the ministry grows, additional help may join on the same principle.
  • Translations & reach. Seed funding for new-language content and partnerships with other small, faithful ministries.

What support is never used for

  • No ad network spending or influencer promotion.
  • No data brokerage or selling of any user information.
  • No selling prayer text, private notes, or personal content.
  • No paywall on the daily Scripture path, basic tools, or core Battle Plans.
  • No hype, no prosperity teaching, no performance pressure—ever.

Questions: support email or contact form (safety/moderation).

The scriptural basis for this model

“As every man hath received the gift, even so minister the same one to another, as good stewards of the manifold grace of God.” —1 Peter 4:10

“And he gave some, apostles; and some, prophets; and some, evangelists; and some, pastors and teachers; For the perfecting of the saints, for the work of the ministry, for the edifying of the body of Christ.” —Ephesians 4:11–12

The site was never meant to be just a verse-a-day service. It was meant to be a place where weary people find the Word—and then learn to stand on it, teach it, live it, and use the gifts God gave them to serve others. Support makes that possible.
